newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK professionals' June pay up 7.9 pct yr-on-yr.
newsitem.headline: HK professionals' June pay up 7.9 pct yr-on-yr.

text.p: Hong Kong's middle managers and professionals saw their salaries rise 7.9 percent year-on-year in June, the government said on Friday.
Stripping the effect of inflation, the real increase stood at 1.2 percent, it said in a statement.

The average salary rate for middle-level managerial and professional employees who did not change jobs or companies was up 10.1 percent over the same period. Real growth, with inflation excluded, was 3.3 percent, it said.
The survey polled 180 companies with a total of 5,754 employees, the statement said.
Apart from basic pay, salary was defined to include cost-of-living allowances, guaranteed year-end extra pay, commissions and tips, and other guaranteed and regular bonuses and allowances.
In Hong Kong, fringe benefits constitute an important element of pay packages for middle managers and professionals.
